description: Vidmoat is an AI video editor built for agents. Tell the built-in AI what you want—or plug in Claude or Cursor—and it automatically cuts dead air, writes karaoke captions, removes backgrounds, and reframes your video for every platform.

defaultPrompt: Take this clip and turn it into a punchy vertical short — cut the silences, add word-synced captions, and render it in 9:16.
Import this footage and tell me what's in it — where the cuts are, which shots are blurry or static.
Create a 15-second promo in my project: bold title, a cartoon sticker of a rocket.
